obtained.how: Internet Archive item 'checklistofnorth1983amer', contributed by the American Museum of Natural History Library to the Biodiversity Heritage Library collection; openly downloadable (not access-restricted)

bibliography.checked_against: the title page (PDF p. 5: 'Check-list of North American Birds … Sixth Edition 1983 … published by the American Ornithologists' Union') and its verso (PDF p. 6: 'Printed by Allen Press, Inc. Lawrence, Kansas'; preferred citation)
bibliography.note: Last printed page is 877 (PDF p. 911). The title page gives no place for the AOU itself; Lawrence, Kansas is the printer's address, as the entry already says.

claims.claim: great blue herons' winter range begins at the southern New England coast (AOU 1983, via Short & Cooper 1985)
claims.quote: southern Ontario and the southern New England coast south throughout the southern United States
claims.conditions: the herodias group's winter range; its northern edge runs from south-coastal Alaska and the Pacific coast across southern Idaho, Nebraska, Missouri, the Ohio Valley and southern Ontario to the southern New England coast
claims.note: The AOU text is now read directly, so the rewrite can cite 'AOU 1983, p. 46' without 'via Short & Cooper 1985'. Maine lies north of this winter limit, consistent with the paper's arrival dates; the same account says the species breeds north to New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island and Nova Scotia (p. 45).

notes: The Check-list gives ranges only (no abundance or dates). Another, borrow-only Internet Archive copy (checklistofnorth0000unse) was not used.
